systems.owner: National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA); the programme is World Bank-funded, with UNDP named as a partner
systems.tiers: at least one million citizens enrolled by November 2025; more than 24 public and private services integrated; target of 15 million IDs by 2029 and a digital version of the card in 2026

note: A report of the second national ID conference in Mogadishu, 24-25 November 2025. It concerns the national identity card only and states nothing about the registration of births or deaths, so no fact is taken.
